001package org.clafer.collection;
002
003import gnu.trove.iterator.TObjectIntIterator;
004import gnu.trove.list.array.TIntArrayList;
005import gnu.trove.map.hash.TIntObjectHashMap;
006import gnu.trove.map.hash.TObjectIntHashMap;
007import java.util.Collection;
008import java.util.HashSet;
009import java.util.Set;
010
011/**
012 *
013 * @param <V> the type of the data
014 * @author jimmy
015 */
016public class DisjointSets<V> {
017
018    private final TObjectIntHashMap<V> nodes;
019    private final TIntArrayList parents;
020
021    public DisjointSets() {
022        nodes = new TObjectIntHashMap<>(16, 0.5f, -1);
023        parents = new TIntArrayList(16);
024    }
025
026    public DisjointSets(DisjointSets<V> copy) {
027        nodes = new TObjectIntHashMap<>(copy.nodes);
028        parents = new TIntArrayList(copy.parents);
029    }
030
031    private int getNode(V i) {
032        int n = nodes.size();
033        int v = nodes.putIfAbsent(i, n);
034        if (v == -1) {
035            parents.add(n);
036            assert nodes.size() == parents.size();
037            return n;
038        }
039        return v;
040    }
041
042    public int representative(V i) {
043        return find(i);
044    }
045
046    private int find(int n) {
047        int p = parents.get(n);
048        if (n == p) {
049            return n;
050        }
051        p = find(p);
052        parents.set(n, p);
053        return p;
054    }
055
056    private int find(V i) {
057        return find(getNode(i));
058    }
059
060    public boolean connected(V i1, V i2) {
061        return find(i1) == find(i2);
062    }
063
064    public void union(V i1, V i2) {
065        int r1 = find(i1);
066        int r2 = find(i2);
067
068        if (r1 != r2) {
069            parents.set(r2, r1);
070        }
071    }
072
073    public Collection<Set<V>> connectedComponents() {
074        TIntObjectHashMap<Set<V>> components = new TIntObjectHashMap<>();
075        TObjectIntIterator<V> iter = nodes.iterator();
076        for (int i = nodes.size(); i-- > 0;) {
077            iter.advance();
078            V key = iter.key();
079            int group = find(iter.value());
080            Set<V> component = components.get(group);
081            if (component == null) {
082                component = new HashSet<>();
083                components.put(group, component);
084            }
085            component.add(key);
086        }
087        return components.valueCollection();
088    }
089
090    @Override
091    public String toString() {
092        return connectedComponents().toString();
093    }
094}
